The logic for `exposure_warning_present` incorrectly sets the value to `true` whenever `qaRow.requires_user_warning` is `true`, effectively bypassing the check for the actual presence of an exposure warning in the promotions. This causes the `exposure_warning_missing` validation error to never be triggered.

```javascript
    exposure_warning_present: qaRow?.requires_user_warning === true
      ? rowPromotions.some((promotion) => promotion?.same_page_exposure_warning_present === true)
      : false,
```
